objective: K23 fix F4 (fix-first): add an opt-in gate so an HTF-window flip does not reset the SWEEP state (EXPANSION/RETEST are already exempt). Default is the legacy rule, so every existing config is byte-identical. Motivation (measured on the recorded 2026-09-23 XAUUSD v2_htfcrt run, config hash 7de09f62): 1,372 of 1,792 SWEEPs (76.6%) die at the 16-bar HTF flip; only 399 (22.3%) reach DISPLACEMENT.
change_class_rationale: Changes a reset gate in ResetLogic.should_reset (CRT state machine) when the flag is true. The flag defaults to false, is read from backtest.htf_reset_exempt_sweep (same optional-with-legacy-default pattern as backtest.htf_clock_basis) and passed CRTEngine -> ResetLogic as a constructor argument. It is deliberately NOT a CRTConfig field: the CRTConfig completeness/authority census pins every field (adding one tripped 7 pinned tests, verified against a 5-red baseline) and F4 belongs next to the HTF clock key it modifies. No feature math, no model, no ontology formula, no production config edit in this change.
rollback_boundary: Remove the htf_reset_exempt_sweep constructor argument from ResetLogic and CRTEngine, the BacktestConfig field/parse/stamp/plumbing in backtest_v2.py, the test file, and this manifest. With the flag false the behaviour is the pre-change behaviour, so rollback is also a no-op for any run that never set it.
authority_granted: User 2026-09-24: K23 fix-first; F4 = exempt SWEEP from the HTF reset; wire it as a backtest-section key + engine kwarg (not a CRTConfig field).
authority_NOT_granted: No shadow config is created or activated, no ACTIVE_VERSION change, no promotion, no F1/F2/F3 change, no G001, no claim that exempting SWEEP improves anything (F-081/F-086 nulls stand), no resolver mirror (deferred), CRT closure stays OPEN.
